newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Traders welcome Empire East buy back.
newsitem.headline: Traders welcome Empire East buy back.

text.p: The proposed share buy back of mass housing builder Empire East Land Holdings Inc would lift confidence of investors in the issue, traders said on Friday.
"The plan would give investors reason to pull back the issue at present levels," said Henry Ong, research head at Sapphire Securities.
Empire East recovered to 5.20 pesos by midsession from the earlier 4.40 on news of the buy back proposal, traders said. The issue closed at 5.80 pesos on Thursday.
"The company probably does not want prices of its stock to fall further because it does not reflect the intrinsic value of the company," Ong added.
"At 5.10 pesos, Empire is trading at five times its projected earnings this year," said Joey Roxas, president at Eagle Equities Inc.
"The issue is now very cheap," he added.

But Manny Cruz, senior investment analyst at Lippo Securities Inc, said he expected the prices of Empire East and its parent Megaworld Properties and Holdings Inc to remain soft for one to two months.
"The sentiment on the property sector is very bearish at this point. People are anticipating a supply glut (in the high-end condominium sector)," he said.
